title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation
title_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的代码生成中的过度自信失败特征分析

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated code generation, but generated programs can appear syntactically plausible while still failing execution-based correctness checks. Existing validation methods, such as testing and program analysis, remain essential but are often incomplete, costly, or applied only after generation. Model-derived uncertainty is therefore a natural early reliability signal.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于自动化代码生成，但生成的程序可能在语法上看似合理，却仍然无法通过基于执行的正确性检查。 现有的验证方法，如测试和程序分析，仍然至关重要，但通常并不完整、成本高昂，或者仅在生成之后才被应用。 因此，模型推导出的不确定性是一种自然的早期可靠性信号。

paragraphs.en: This paper studies the dilemma of overconfidence in code LLMs where incorrect programs are often generated with token-level confidence comparable to correct programs. We study this dilemma across four open-source code models and three execution-based benchmarks. Our analysis begins by investigating whether existing uncertainty metrics provide reliable proxies for execution correctness in code generation. We then characterize overconfidence at both global and local token levels, asking whether incorrect programs remain indistinguishable from correct ones under confidence and entropy summaries, including selective generation and the limits of instruction tuning. Finally, we evaluate whether common mitigation strategies reduce this failure mode, and we examine latent representations as exploratory evidence for future reliability mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了代码大型语言模型中过度自信的两难困境：错误程序常常以与正确程序相当的字符级置信度被生成。 我们通过四个开源代码模型和三个基于执行的基准测试，对这一两难困境进行了研究。 我们的分析首先探究现有不确定性指标能否为代码生成中的执行正确性提供可靠的代理指标。 接着，我们从全局和局部字符两个层面描述了过度自信现象，并探讨了在置信度和熵值摘要中，错误程序是否仍无法与正确程序区分开来，包括选择性生成和指令调教的局限性。 最后，我们评估了常见缓解策略能否减少这种故障模式，并考察了潜在表示作为未来可靠性机制的探索性证据。

paragraphs.en: Our study yields four findings. First, existing uncertainty signals provide only partial and model-dependent evidence of execution failure. Second, overconfidence persists at both program and token levels, and uncertainty-based selection does not consistently improve accepted-set accuracy. Third, instruction tuning can increase certainty on failing generations without consistently improving correctness discrimination. Fourth, common mitigation techniques improve specific aspects of reliability but do not reliably resolve overconfident failure. Our exploratory latent analysis suggests that hidden representations may encode correctness-related signals that output confidence does not expose. Together, these findings identify overconfident failure as a software-engineering reliability problem and offer a practical path toward building more reliable LLM-driven code-generation systems.

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly effective at code generation, synthesizing implementations from natural-language specifications, programming tasks, and partial code contexts ( Roziere et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Liu et al., 2024b ) . They are now integrated into software development workflows to assist with implementation, debugging, testing, and repair ( GitHub, 2021 ; OpenAI, 2021 ; DeepMind, 2025 ; DeepMind, 2022 ) . However, generated code is not self-validating. A program may be syntactically valid, idiomatic, and plausible while still violating the intended specification, especially on edge cases revealed only through execution. Thus, a central reliability challenge for LLM-based software engineering is not only whether a model can generate code, but whether a system can determine when generated code should be trusted.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面的效果日益显著，能够根据自然语言规范、编程任务和部分代码上下文合成实现方案（Roziere 等，2023；Guo 等，2024；Jiang 等，2024；Liu 等，2023a；Liu 等，2024b）。 目前，它们已被集成到软件开发流程中，用于辅助实现、调试、测试和修复（GitHub，2021；OpenAI，2021；DeepMind，2025；DeepMind，2022）。 然而，生成的代码无法自我验证。 一个程序可能在语法上有效、符合惯例且看似合理，但仍可能违反其预期规范，尤其是在仅通过执行才能暴露的边缘情况下。 因此，基于大型语言模型的软件工程面临的核心可靠性挑战，不仅在于模型能否生成代码，更在于系统能否判断何时应当信任所生成的代码。

paragraphs.en: Existing validation approaches primarily rely on execution-based evaluation ( Li et al., 2024a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) or program analysis ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Shaikhelislamov et al., 2024 ; Chapman et al., 2024 ) . These techniques are essential, but they do not fully solve the deployment-time reliability problem. Execution requires tests, input generators, or behavioral oracles, which may be incomplete, expensive, or unavailable for each generated candidate. Program analysis can identify specific defect classes, but it is often conservative, property-specific, and does not generally estimate whether an arbitrary generated program satisfies its specification. Moreover, both execution and analysis are typically applied after generation. This limits their ability to provide lightweight, model-intrinsic reliability signals during interactive code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的验证方法主要依赖基于执行的评估（Li et al., 2024a；Peng et al., 2025；Ni et al., 2023；Tian et al., 2025）或程序分析（Yao et al., 2025；Shaikhelislamov et al., 2024；Chapman et al., 2024）。 这些技术至关重要，但并未完全解决部署时的可靠性问题。 执行方法需要测试用例、输入生成器或行为预言机，而这些资源对于每个生成的候选程序可能都不完整、成本高昂或无法获取。 程序分析能够识别特定类型的缺陷，但通常较为保守、局限于特定属性，且一般无法判断任意生成的程序是否满足其规格要求。 此外，执行和分析通常在生成之后才进行应用。 这限制了它们在交互式代码生成过程中提供轻量级、模型内在的可靠性信号的能力。

paragraphs.en: A natural alternative is an uncertainty-aware code-generation system. In an ideal setting, the system would know whether a generated program generalizes to unseen tests or real user inputs. Such a generalizability oracle is unavailable in practice, because functional correctness can only be established through validation against a specification, tests, or downstream behavior. Therefore practical systems must rely on proxies . The broader machine-learning literature operationalizes this proxy through uncertainty metrics derived from predictive distributions, confidence scores, entropy, margins, calibration methods, and related quantities. Such metrics have been extensively studied in classification tasks ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2018 ; Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ; Alon et al., 2019 ; Xiao and Wang, 2019 ; Vasudevan et al., 2019 ; Corbière et al., 2019 ; Monarch, 2021 ; Steinhardt and Liang, 2016 ; Shannon, 1948 ) and more recently in natural language generation (NLG) ( Vashurin et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Bakman et al., 2025 ; Ielanskyi et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) , where they are used as proxies for output correctness, factuality, or risk. These estimates also support selective abstention ( Xin et al., 2021 ; Calder et al., 1999 ; Gu and Hopkins, 2023 ) , where high-risk outputs are withheld or routed to additional validation.
paragraphs.zh: 一种自然的替代方案是具备不确定性感知能力的代码生成系统。 在理想情况下，该系统能够判断生成的程序是否适用于未见的测试用例或真实用户输入。 实际上并不存在这样的泛化能力判定机制，因为功能正确性只能通过对照规范、测试或下游行为进行验证来确立。 因此，实际系统必须依赖代理指标。 更广泛的机器学习文献通过预测分布、置信度分数、熵、余量、校准方法及相关量所推导出的不确定性指标，将这种代理指标具体化。 这类指标在分类任务中得到了广泛研究（Guo et al., 2017；Wang et al., 2020；Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2018；Gal and Ghahramani, 2016；Alon et al., 2019；Xiao and Wang, 2019；Vasudevan et al., 2019；Corbière et al., 2019；Monarch, 2021；Steinhardt and Liang, 2016；Shannon, 1948），近期也应用于自然语言生成（NLG）领域（Vashurin et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2025；Xia et al., 2025；Bakman et al., 2025；Ielanskyi et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2025），其中它们被用作输出正确性、事实性或风险的代理指标。 这些估计值还支持选择性拒绝（Xin et al., 2021；Calder et al., 1999；Gu and Hopkins, 2023），即对高风险输出进行保留或转至额外验证流程。

paragraphs.en: However, uncertainty is less directly related to correctness in code generation than in classification or open-ended NLG. In classification, uncertainty is defined over the label distribution, and evaluation is performed on the predicted label. In open-ended NLG, uncertainty is commonly estimated over the generated response and evaluated against response-level properties such as correctness or factuality. In code generation, model probabilities are assigned during token generation, whereas correctness is determined by the execution behavior of the completed program. Therefore, a generated program can have high token likelihood and still fail to satisfy its specification. Thus, token- and sequence-level uncertainty are only proxies for execution correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，与分类或开放式自然语言生成不同，不确定性在代码生成中与正确性的直接关联较弱。 在分类任务中，不确定性是针对标签分布定义的，而评估则基于预测的标签进行。 在开放式自然语言生成中，不确定性通常针对生成的响应进行估计，并依据响应层面的属性（如正确性或事实性）进行评估。 在代码生成中，模型概率是在生成词元时分配的，而正确性则由完整程序的执行行为决定。 因此，一个生成的程序可能具有极高的词元似然度，但仍可能无法满足其规格要求。 由此可见，词元和序列层面的不确定性只是执行正确性的间接指标。

paragraphs.en: Using token- and sequence-level uncertainty as proxies for execution correctness creates a dilemma of overconfidence in code generation. A generated program may receive high model confidence and still fail execution-based evaluation. This mismatch is consistent with how code LLMs are trained and evaluated. First, autoregressive training optimizes next-token prediction rather than whether model confidence reflects execution correctness. Second, standard code-generation evaluation measures generation success rather than the reliability of model confidence. Pass@1 and pass@k measure ( Li et al., 2024a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) whether generated programs pass the evaluation tests, whereas binary grading gives no credit to abstention ( Kalai et al., 2025 ) . Therefore, such evaluation does not assess whether failing generations receive lower confidence than passing ones. paragraphs.en: There is growing research interest in using uncertainty to support reliable code generation. Existing studies pursue three main directions. First, they evaluate uncertainty estimators as predictors of code correctness ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Vasconcelos et al., 2022 ) . Second, they calibrate confidence against observed correctness or use uncertainty to support abstention and other reliability decisions ( Spiess et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Sharma and David, 2025 ; Johnson et al., 2023b ; Rathnasuriya and Yang, 2026 ) . Third, recent studies examine how uncertainty behaves when it is used to guide candidate selection, correction, or other generation-time decisions ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Rakasi et al., 2026 ) . These studies show that uncertainty can provide useful information about correctness, but their evaluations mainly measure estimator performance or the effectiveness of an uncertainty-guided decision rule. However, important questions remain about the reliability of uncertainty as a proxy for execution correctness. Prior studies demonstrate that uncertainty can be informative, but they do not fully establish the extent to which it remains reliable when passing and failing generations receive similar uncertainty scores. It also remains unclear where this mismatch arises during generation, under which conditions it persists, and whether and to what extent common mitigation strategies can address it. Addressing these questions requires a systematic characterization of the reliability limits of model-derived uncertainty in code generation.

paragraphs.en: To characterize the reliability limits of model-derived uncertainty, we first conduct a preliminary study of existing uncertainty measures (Section 4 ). Across 17 generation-stage metrics and six prefill-stage metrics, no measure provides stable failure ranking across models and benchmarks. We then examine overconfidence through token confidence and predictive entropy at both program and token levels (Section 5 ). Failing programs often remain highly certain, including within their least-confident token regions. This misalignment affects selective generation where reducing coverage does not consistently increase selective accuracy and can decrease it when failures occupy high-certainty regions. Furthermore, instruction tuning can also increase certainty on failing generations without a corresponding improvement in correctness discrimination. These findings show that overconfidence is a distinct reliability problem where improvements in generation accuracy do not necessarily improve the model’s ability to identify which generations are likely correct.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we evaluate whether common mitigation techniques reduce overconfident failure (Section 6 ). Moreover, explicit abstention prompting likewise does not reliably induce deferral on incorrect generations. As an exploratory analysis, we find systematic pass–fail differences in latent-state geometry that are not reflected in output-token confidence. These results show that improving generation success or confidence calibration does not necessarily eliminate overconfident failure.

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We formulate the dilemma of overconfidence in code LLMs as a barrier to practical uncertainty-aware code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将代码大语言模型中过度自信的困境，视为阻碍实用型不确定性感知代码生成的障碍。

paragraphs.en: We show that existing uncertainty signals provide only partial and model-dependent evidence of execution failure across both prefill and generation stages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，现有的不确定性信号在预填充和生成两个阶段中，仅能提供部分且依赖于模型的执行失败证据。

paragraphs.en: We characterize overconfidence at program and token levels, and show that it can persist under selective generation and after instruction tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在程序和词元层面描述了过度自信现象，并证明它在选择性生成和指令微调之后仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate post-hoc calibration, repeated sampling, and explicit abstention, showing that none reliably resolves overconfident failure despite improving specific aspects of reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了事后校准、重复采样和显式弃权三种方法，结果表明，尽管这些方法在可靠性方面有所提升，但都无法可靠地解决过度自信导致的失败问题。

paragraphs.en: We provide exploratory evidence that latent representations contain correctness-related structure not reflected in output uncertainty, motivating representation-aware reliability mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了探索性证据，表明潜在表示中包含了与正确性相关的结构，而这些结构并未反映在输出不确定性中，这为开发感知表示的可靠性机制提供了动机。

In an ideal code-generation system (Figure 1(a) ), a generalization oracle would determine whether a generated program generalizes to unseen tests, real inputs, or downstream use. Such an oracle is not available a priori, because functional correctness must be established through validation against specifications, tests, formal properties, or observed behavior.

paragraphs.en: We also distinguish when the signal is measured. Prefill-stage signals are computed before any code tokens are emitted, using only the prompt and the model’s initial processing. They may capture prompt difficulty, ambiguity, or underspecification, but they cannot observe implementation-specific errors. Decoding-stage signals are computed from generated tokens, token distributions, hidden states, or sampled candidates. These signals are closer to the final program, but they may still reflect local fluency or memorized coding patterns rather than functional correctness.

paragraphs.en: The underlying challenge is that model confidence and program correctness characterize different properties. Token-level confidence reflects the probability assigned to decoding decisions, whereas execution evaluates the semantics of the completed program. Therefore, a semantically incorrect implementation can receive high token-level confidence despite failing execution. Figure 1(c) illustrates this mismatch under the same specification: the passing implementation compares all element pairs, whereas the failing implementation checks only adjacent pairs. Despite this semantic difference, both generations receive comparable token confidence.
paragraphs.zh: 根本性的挑战在于，模型置信度和程序正确性分别表征了不同的属性。 词元级置信度反映了解码决策所分配的概率，而执行则评估已完成程序的语义。 因此，一个语义上错误的实现尽管执行失败，仍可能获得较高的词元级置信度。 图 1(c) 展示了在相同规范下这种不匹配的情况：通过的实现会比较所有元素对，而失败的实现仅检查相邻元素对。 尽管存在这种语义差异，两种生成结果都获得了相当接近的词元置信度。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate generated code on three execution-based benchmarks: HumanEval+ , MBPP+ , and BigCodeBench . HumanEval+ ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023b ) and MBPP+ ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Dong et al., 2025 ) extend widely used function-level code-generation benchmarks with stronger test suites from EvalPlus ( Liu et al., 2023a ) . HumanEval+ contains 164 programming tasks specified by function signatures and natural-language descriptions. The MBPP+ evaluation set contains 378 tasks derived from introductory programming problems. These two benchmarks provide controlled function-level settings for evaluating execution correctness. BigCodeBench ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) broadens the evaluation to programming tasks with richer contexts, more complex instructions, and greater use of library APIs. It contains 1,140 Python tasks spanning 723 function calls from 139 libraries across seven domains. We include BigCodeBench to examine whether overconfident failure persists beyond controlled function-level tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个基于执行的基准测试上评估生成的代码：HumanEval+、MBPP+ 和 BigCodeBench。 HumanEval+（Chen 等人，2021；Liu 等人，2023b）和 MBPP+（Liu 等人，2023b；Dong 等人，2025）在广泛使用的函数级代码生成基准测试基础上，加入了来自 EvalPlus（Liu 等人，2023a）的更严格的测试套件。 HumanEval+ 包含 164 个通过函数签名和自然语言描述定义的编程任务。 MBPP+ 评估集包含 378 个源自入门级编程问题的任务。 这两个基准测试为评估执行正确性提供了受控的函数级设置。 BigCodeBench（Zhuo 等人，2025）将评估范围扩展到具有更丰富上下文、更复杂指令以及更多库 API 使用的编程任务。 它包含 1,140 个 Python 任务，涵盖来自 139 个库的 723 个函数调用，涉及七个领域。 我们引入 BigCodeBench，旨在探究过度自信的失败现象是否在受控的函数级任务之外仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: We select these models based on four criteria. First, their open-source availability enables access to token-level statistics, prefill-stage signals, and internal representations. Second, restricting the models to 7-8B parameters reduces variation attributable to model scale. Third, all models are specialized and instruction-tuned for code generation. Fourth, the models originate from different development lineages, reducing the risk that the observed behavior is specific to one training pipeline. For the post-training analysis in Section 5.5 , we additionally compare base and instruction-tuned variants of OpenCoder and DeepSeekCoder . All experiments were conducted on a server equipped with an Intel(R) Xeon(R) w5-2545 CPU and four NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPUs.

paragraphs.en: We investigate overconfident failure through the following research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过以下研究问题来探究过度自信导致的失败。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: To what extent do existing uncertainty signals reflect the likelihood of generation correctness?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：现有的不确定性信号在多大程度上反映了生成结果的正确性概率？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How does overconfident failure manifest, and under what conditions does it persist in code generation?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：过度自信的失败以何种形式表现？在什么条件下，它会在代码生成中持续存在？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: To what extent do existing mitigation strategies reduce overconfident failure?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3：现有的缓解策略能在多大程度上减少过度自信的失败？

paragraphs.en: RQ4: Do latent representations contain correctness information not exposed by output uncertainty?
paragraphs.zh: 问题4：潜在表示是否包含输出不确定性所未揭示的正确性信息？

paragraphs.en: This section addresses RQ1 in Section 3.2 by examining to what extent standard uncertainty signals reliably indicate the likelihood that generated code will fail. This research question serves as an initial diagnostic analysis: if existing metrics consistently separate passing from failing programs, then overconfident failure would be less concerning for selective code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 本节通过考察标准不确定性信号在多大程度上能可靠地指示所生成代码可能失败的可能性，来探讨第 3.2 节中的研究问题 1（RQ1）。 这一研究问题是一项初步的诊断性分析：如果现有指标能够始终如一地区分成功与失败的程序，那么对于选择性代码生成而言，过度自信的失败情况将不再那么令人担忧。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Setup. For each generated solution, we compute 17 generation-stage uncertainty scores. We also compute six prefill scores: end-of-prompt next-token MSP, entropy, margin, energy, mean token entropy, and mean negative log-likelihood. Table 2 summarizes the evaluated metrics. For metrics that require multiple generations, we sample up to 10 candidates per prompt at temperature 1.0.
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 对于每个生成的解决方案，我们计算 17 个生成阶段的置信度分数。 我们还计算六个预填充分数：提示结尾的下一个词 MSP、熵、余量、能量、平均词元熵和平均负对数似然。 表 2 总结了所评估的各项指标。 对于需要多次生成的指标，我们在温度设为 1.0 的情况下，每个提示最多采样 10 个候选方案。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each score using AUC, with fail as the positive class, and orient the scores so that larger values indicate greater estimated failure risk. An AUC of 0.5 corresponds to random ranking. We focus on HumanEval+ and MBPP+ because both passing and failing generations are sufficiently represented across the studied models. We exclude BigCodeBench because its substantially lower pass rates leave few passing generations for several models, making pass-fail discrimination estimates less stable. Full metric definitions and implementation details are available on the project website ( CodeCalibration, ) .

paragraphs.en: Finding. The limited failure discrimination is not specific to one uncertainty formulation or one stage of inference. Across 17 generation-stage signals and six prefill signals, no uncertainty measure provides stable failure ranking across models and benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: Implication. The results do not support a model- and task-independent mapping from standard uncertainty scores to code correctness. Furthermore, an uncertainty signal that is useful in one setting cannot be assumed to provide the same failure evidence in another.
paragraphs.zh: 含义。 研究结果不支持一种与模型和任务无关的映射方法，即从标准的置信度分数到代码正确性的映射。 此外，不能假设在一种情境下有用的置信度信号，在另一种情境下也能提供相同的失败证据。

paragraphs.en: SE Takeaway. Code-generation tools should not reuse uncertainty thresholds across models or workloads. Acceptance and validation policies should be re-evaluated for each deployment setting because the same uncertainty signal can provide different failure discrimination across settings.
paragraphs.zh: SE 要点。 代码生成工具不应在不同模型或工作负载之间重复使用不确定性阈值。 对于每次部署环境，都应重新评估接受和验证策略，因为相同的不确定性信号在不同环境中可能提供不同的故障判别能力。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we answer RQ2 by characterizing how overconfidence manifests across the code-generation process. We examine whether failing programs remain highly confident overall, whether local token behavior exposes regions of uncertainty, and whether predictive entropy provides additional evidence of failure. We further study the effect of these uncertainty signals on selective accuracy and examine whether overconfidence persists after instruction tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们通过描述过度自信在代码生成过程中以何种方式体现出来，来回答研究问题 RQ2。 我们考察了失败程序在整体上是否仍然保持高度自信、局部词元行为是否会暴露出不确定区域，以及预测熵是否为失败提供了额外证据。 我们还进一步研究了这些不确定性信号对选择性准确性的影响，并考察了在指令微调之后过度自信是否仍然存在。

Evaluation Setup. We next measure confidence over the generated code. For each solution, we compute average token confidence as the mean probability assigned to emitted tokens. To test whether failures are exposed by localized uncertainty, we also compute bottom-10% confidence, defined as the mean confidence of the least confident 10% of generated tokens. We compare passing and failing generations using mean, standard deviation, median, and Welch’s two-sample (t)-test.
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 接下来，我们测量生成代码的置信度。 对于每个解决方案，我们将平均词元置信度计算为已输出词元所分配概率的平均值。 为了检验局部不确定性是否会导致失败，我们还计算了最低 10% 的置信度，其定义为生成词元中置信度最低的 10% 的平均置信度。 我们使用均值、标准差、中位数以及韦尔奇双样本（t）检验来比较成功和失败的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: Results. Table 4 shows that both correct and incorrect programs receive high average token confidence. On HumanEval+ and MBPP+, average confidence is typically above 0.90 for both groups. Although correct solutions often have slightly higher confidence, the absolute gaps are small. For example, on HumanEval+, the correct–incorrect average-confidence gap ranges from 0.007 to 0.012 across models. On MBPP+, the gap is even smaller for several models, including OpenCoder, where correct and incorrect generations have nearly identical average confidence.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 表4显示，正确和错误的程序都获得了较高的平均令牌置信度。 在 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 上，两组的平均置信度通常都高于 0.90。 尽管正确解的平均置信度往往略高，但绝对差异很小。 例如，在 HumanEval+ 上，不同模型中正确与错误解的平均置信度差距在 0.007 到 0.012 之间。 在 MBPP+ 上，某些模型（包括 OpenCoder）的差距更小，其中正确和错误的生成结果的平均置信度几乎完全相同。

paragraphs.en: The pattern becomes more striking on BigCodeBench. For CodeLlama and QwenCoder, incorrect generations have higher average confidence than correct generations. CodeLlama assigns mean confidence 0.956 to incorrect generations and 0.943 to correct generations, while QwenCoder assigns 0.920 to incorrect generations and 0.897 to correct generations. These negative t t -statistics, which are statistically significant under standard two-sample t t -tests, indicate that the observed differences are unlikely to be due to random variation; rather, they reveal a systematic confidence–failure mismatch, where the models are most confident precisely when they are wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 在 BigCodeBench 上，这一模式变得更加明显。 对于 CodeLlama 和 QwenCoder，错误生成的平均置信度高于正确生成。 CodeLlama 为错误生成分配的置信度均值为 0.956，而正确生成则为 0.943；QwenCoder 则分别为错误生成分配 0.920，正确生成分配 0.897。 这些负 t 值在标准双样本 t 检验中具有统计学显著性，表明观察到的差异不太可能是由随机波动引起的；相反，它们揭示了一种系统性的置信度与失败之间的不匹配：模型恰恰在出错时表现出最高的置信度。

paragraphs.en: Program-level confidence may hide isolated generation steps at which the model is uncertain. Therefore, we examine the least-confident tokens (i.e., the bottom 10% by confidence) within each generated program to determine whether failures contain localized uncertainty that is not reflected in the overall confidence score.
paragraphs.zh: 程序级别的置信度可能会掩盖模型存在不确定性的孤立生成步骤。 因此，我们检查每个生成程序中置信度最低的词元（即置信度最低的前 10%），以确定失败是否包含未反映在整体置信度分数中的局部不确定性。

paragraphs.en: We further examine predictive entropy as a complementary measure of generation-time uncertainty. At each generation step, predictive entropy is computed from the model’s probability distribution over all possible next tokens. Entropy is low when probability mass is concentrated on a small set of candidates and high when it is distributed more broadly across alternatives. Unlike token confidence, which considers only the probability assigned to the emitted token, predictive entropy accounts for the full next-token distribution. We test whether this broader uncertainty signal better distinguishes failing from passing generations. If predictive entropy reflects functional correctness, failing generations should exhibit systematically higher entropy than passing generations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将预测熵视为生成时间不确定性的补充性度量。 在每个生成步骤中，预测熵是根据模型对所有可能下一个词元的概率分布计算得出的。 当概率质量集中在少数候选项上时，熵值较低；而当其更广泛地分布在多个选项之间时，熵值则较高。 与仅考虑已输出词元概率的词元置信度不同，预测熵涵盖了完整的下一个词元分布。 我们检验这种更广泛的不确定性信号是否能够更好地区分失败的生成和成功的生成。 如果预测熵能够反映功能正确性，那么失败的生成应当表现出系统性地高于成功生成的熵值。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Setup. We compare base and instruction-tuned variants of OpenCoder and DeepSeekCoder on MBPP+. However, this change in certainty does not determine whether uncertainty becomes more or less informative about functional correctness. For example, DeepSeekCoder becomes more certain on failing generations while its pass-fail discrimination improves. paragraphs.en: Our characterization separates three properties of reliability-aware code generation: functional accuracy, uncertainty-based correctness discrimination, and its stability after post-training. Pass/fail evaluation measures only the first and the latter two determine whether model uncertainty remains informative for reliability decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的特征分析将可靠性感知代码生成的三个属性区分开来：功能准确性、基于不确定性的正确性判别，以及其在后续训练后的稳定性。 通过/失败评估仅衡量第一个属性，而后两个属性则决定了模型的不确定性是否仍能为可靠性决策提供有效信息。

paragraphs.en: Reliability evaluation should measure correctness discrimination separately from task accuracy. A model can achieve higher Pass@1 without becoming better at identifying which of its generations are correct. Therefore, evaluation should report whether uncertainty separates passing from failing programs in addition to reporting functional accuracy. Coverage-accuracy analysis provides a corresponding view by showing whether uncertainty ranking yields more accurate accepted subsets.

paragraphs.en: Post-training objectives for correctness do not necessarily improve self-assessment. Our base-instruction comparison shows that model certainty and correctness discrimination can change independently after instruction tuning. Therefore, improving generation quality does not impose a corresponding constraint on confidence assigned to remaining failures. Reliability oriented post-training should treat generation correctness and uncertainty-based self-assessment as separate optimization targets.
paragraphs.zh: 用于提升正确性的训练后目标并不一定能改善自我评估能力。 我们对基础指令的对比表明，在指令微调之后，模型的确信度与正确性判别能力可以独立变化。 因此，提升生成质量并不会对剩余错误所分配的信心值施加相应的约束。 以可靠性为导向的训练后过程应将生成正确性与基于不确定性的自我评估视为独立的优化目标。

Model evolution should include regression evaluation of both functional accuracy and uncertainty-correctness alignment.

paragraphs.en: SE Takeaway. Overconfidence is not reduced automatically by improving code-generation accuracy. Post-training can increase functional performance while high-certainty failures persist, making overconfidence a distinct reliability property that must be assessed independently.

paragraphs.en: This section answers RQ3 on the effectiveness of common mitigation techniques for reducing overconfident failure. We evaluate three practical responses: post-hoc calibration, repeated sampling, and explicit abstention prompting. These strategies address different parts of the reliability problem where calibration rescales scores, sampling increases the chance of finding a correct candidate, and abstention prompting gives the model an explicit option to defer.
paragraphs.zh: 本节回答了研究问题 RQ3，即常见缓解技术对于减少过度自信失败的有效性。 我们评估了三种实际应对方法：事后校准、重复采样以及显式拒绝提示。 这些策略针对可靠性问题的不同方面：校准会重新调整分数，采样会增加找到正确候选项的可能性，而拒绝提示则为模型提供了一个明确的推诿选项。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Setup. We examine to what extent post-hoc calibration mitigates overconfidence by mapping uncertainty scores to estimated probabilities of execution correctness. For confidence, we use average token confidence and bottom-10% token confidence. For entropy, we use average token entropy and top-10% token entropy. We calibrate each score using Platt scaling (PS) ( Spiess et al., 2024 ) which fits a logistic mapping from each original uncertainty score to an estimated probability of correctness and isotonic regression ( Guo et al., 2017 ) which fits a monotonic non-parametric mapping from uncertainty scores to empirical correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 我们考察事后校准在多大程度上通过将不确定性分数映射到执行正确性的估计概率上来缓解过度自信。 对于置信度，我们使用平均词元置信度和最低 10% 的词元置信度。 对于熵值，我们使用平均词元熵和最高 10% 的词元熵。 我们对每个分数进行校准，分别使用 Platt 缩放（PS）（Spiess 等，2024），该方法为每个原始不确定性分数拟合一个到正确性估计概率的逻辑斯蒂映射；以及等温回归（Guo 等，2017），该方法为不确定性分数到经验正确性拟合一个单调非参数化映射。

Lower BS indicates better probability alignment. Because a constant predictor equal to the benchmark pass rate can also achieve a low BS, we additionally report Brier Skill Score (BSS) ( Spiess et al., 2024 ) . For pass rate p r p_{r} , the reference score is B ref = p r ​ ( 1 − p r ) B_{\mathrm{ref}}=p_{r}(1-p_{r}) , and the skill score is B ​ S ​ S = ( B ref − B ​ S ) / B ref BSS=(B_{\mathrm{ref}}-BS)/B_{\mathrm{ref}} . paragraphs.en: Results. Table 5 reports the calibration results on MBPP+ and BigCodeBench. Across both benchmarks, calibration substantially reduces Brier score, but the resulting Brier Skill Scores remain minimal. On MBPP+, calibration substantially reduces BS, but the calibrated probabilities provide little skill beyond the benchmark pass rate. For CodeLlama, PS reduces the BS of average token confidence from 0.459 to 0.248, while BSS is approximately 0.001. DeepSeekCoder shows a similar pattern where BS decreases from 0.300 to 0.224, but BSS remains approximately 0.001. For OpenCoder, BS decreases from 0.250 to 0.205 while BSS remains near zero. paragraphs.en: The BS and BSS results show that calibration primarily corrects the scale of the uncertainty scores rather than providing substantial predictive information about individual generations. paragraphs.en: Evaluation Setup. We next evaluate whether repeated sampling can compensate for overconfident single generations. We run four code models on MBPP+ and generate up to (K=50) candidate programs per task using temperature sampling with (T=0.8). Each candidate is executed against the task test suite. For each task, we record whether a passing solution appears within the first (k) samples and how many passing candidates appear within the full budget.

paragraphs.en: Results. Figure 5 shows that sampling reduces the number of unsolved tasks quickly at small budgets, but the curves flatten as (K) increases. Even after 50 attempts, many tasks remain unsolved, i.e., roughly 90 for CodeLlama, about 57 for DeepSeek, and around 45–50 for OpenCoder and QwenCoder. Figure 5(b) shows that sampling mostly separates tasks into reliably solved and persistently unsolved groups, with fewer partially recoverable cases.

paragraphs.en: These results characterize sampling as a bounded recovery mechanism rather than a reliability mechanism. Additional samples can recover failures that are sensitive to decoding variation, but the flattening curves show that many tasks remain unresolved even after substantial retry budget. In a software-engineering workflow, each retry also incurs generation cost, latency, and additional validation effort. Thus, sampling does not remove the accept-or-defer decision; it shifts the decision to budget allocation. A practical system must decide when another sample is likely to help, when a task should be escalated, and how to identify which candidate is trustworthy when multiple candidates are available.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，采样是一种有界恢复机制，而非可靠性机制。 额外的样本可以恢复那些对解码变化敏感的故障，但曲线平坦化现象显示，即使投入大量重试资源，许多任务仍然无法解决。 在软件工程工作流程中，每次重试还会产生生成成本、延迟以及额外的验证工作。 因此，采样并未消除“接受或推迟”的决策；它只是将这一决策转移到了预算分配环节。 一个实用的系统必须决定：何时再次采样可能有所帮助，何时应升级任务处理，以及在有多个候选方案时如何识别出可信的方案。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Setup. We test whether explicit prompting can make a model defer when it is unlikely to be correct. We use a penalty-aware prompt that instructs the model to answer only when it is more than 95% confident and to otherwise output “I don’t know” . This tests whether a code LLM can convert uncertainty into abstention without additional control logic.
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 我们测试明确提示能否使模型在判断结果可能不正确时选择推脱。 我们使用一种具备惩罚意识的提示，指示模型仅在置信度超过 95% 时作答，否则输出“我不知道”。 此举旨在测试代码 LLM 是否能在没有额外控制逻辑的情况下，将不确定性转化为弃权。

sents.en: We use a penalty-aware prompt that instructs the model to answer only when it is more than 95% confident and to otherwise output “I don’t know” .
sents.zh: 我们使用一种具备惩罚意识的提示，指示模型仅在置信度超过 95% 时作答，否则输出“我不知道”。

paragraphs.en: Results. Figure 6 shows a representative failure on MBPP/72 for OpenCoder. The prompt instructs the model to answer only when confident and assigns a high penalty to mistakes, while allowing “I don’t know” as a zero-cost response. Nevertheless, the model generates code rather than deferring. The generated program checks whether the input can be represented as a sum of two squares (line 5), while the task asks for the difference of two squares. We observe the same qualitative pattern across the subject models: even when abstention is explicitly allowed, the standard code-LLMs behavior favors producing a concrete program instead of deferring. In SE terms, the model continues to behave as a generator rather than as a reliability-aware component.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 图6展示了OpenCoder在MBPP/72任务上的一个典型失败案例。 该提示词要求模型仅在确信时作答，并对错误施加高额惩罚，同时允许使用“我不知道”作为零成本回应。 然而，模型仍然生成了代码，而非选择推诿。 生成的程序检查输入是否可以表示为两个平方数之和（第5行），而任务实际要求的是两个平方数之差。 我们在所有测试模型中观察到了相同的质量模式：即使明确允许推诿，标准代码LLM的行为仍倾向于生成具体程序，而非选择推诿。 从软件工程的角度来看，该模型仍然表现为一个生成器，而非一个具备可靠性意识的组件。

sents.zh: 从软件工程的角度来看，该模型仍然表现为一个生成器，而非一个具备可靠性意识的组件。

paragraphs.en: Finding. Prompt-level abstention does not reliably induce deferral; models can still generate incorrect code even when an IDK option is provided.

sents.en: Finding.
sents.zh: 查找。

sents.en: Prompt-level abstention does not reliably induce deferral; models can still generate incorrect code even when an IDK option is provided.
sents.zh: 提示层级的拒绝并不能可靠地引发转交；即使提供了“不知道”选项，模型仍然可能生成错误的代码。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that generation quality and correctness-sensitive confidence are distinct reliability properties. Improving the probability of generating correct code does not necessarily improve the separation between correct and incorrect generations in confidence. Overconfidence exposes this gap because incorrect generations can remain highly confident even when generation quality or probability alignment improves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，生成质量和对正确性敏感的置信度是两种不同的可靠性属性。 提高生成正确代码的概率并不必然能增强正确生成与错误生成之间的置信度差异。 过度自信会暴露这一差距，因为即使生成质量或概率一致性得到改善，错误生成的结果仍可能保持高置信度。

sents.en: Our results suggest that generation quality and correctness-sensitive confidence are distinct reliability properties.
sents.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，生成质量和对正确性敏感的置信度是两种不同的可靠性属性。

paragraphs.en: SE Takeaway. Code-generation reliability should be evaluated along both dimensions. Pass rate measures whether a model produces correct programs, whereas overconfident failure captures whether incorrect programs remain highly trusted by the model’s confidence signal. Improvement in generation quality should not be interpreted as a corresponding reduction in overconfidence.

paragraphs.en: Research Insight. Overconfidence motivates treating correctness-sensitive confidence as an explicit learning objective rather than an expected consequence of better code generation. Future techniques should aim to reduce confidence on incorrect generations while preserving confidence on correct generations. This formulation extends the reliability objective from producing correct code to distinguishing which generated code can be trusted.

paragraphs.en: This section addresses RQ4 by investigating overconfident failure signals in latent representation-space of code-LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 本节通过研究代码大语言模型（code-LLMs）潜在表示空间中的过度自信失败信号，来回答研究问题RQ4。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Setup. Inspired by recent latent-space analyses of reasoning models ( Du et al., 2025 ) , we analyze the latent representation space across transformer layers. For each generated solution, we feed the prompt and generated code to the model and compute hidden-state statistics only over the generated solution tokens. We focus on effective rank ( Wei et al., 2024 ) , which summarizes how many representation directions are effectively used at a layer. Given a hidden-state matrix ( H ℓ H_{\ell} ) at layer ( ℓ \ell ), effective rank is computed from the normalized singular-value spectrum of ( H ℓ H_{\ell} ). Higher effective rank indicates a more dispersed representation, while lower effective rank indicates a more compact representation.
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 受近期对推理模型潜在空间的分析（Du et al., 2025）启发，我们分析了Transformer各层中的潜在表示空间。 对于每个生成的解决方案，我们将提示和生成的代码输入模型，并仅针对生成的解决方案的标记计算隐藏状态统计量。 我们关注有效秩（Wei et al., 2024），它总结了某一层中实际被使用的表示方向的数量。 给定第（ℓ）层的隐藏状态矩阵（Hℓ），有效秩可通过对（Hℓ）进行归一化的奇异值谱计算得出。 较高的有效秩表示表示更为分散，而较低的有效秩则表示表示更为紧凑。

paragraphs.en: Results. Figure 7 compares layerwise effective rank for CodeLlama and QwenCoder on HumanEval+. Although the models operate at different pass@1 levels, both show the same pattern: failing generations have higher effective rank than passing generations across many middle and later layers. This indicates that failing generations induce a less compact hidden-state geometry. This contrasts with RQ2, where output-token confidence often failed to separate passing from failing programs. The result suggests that correctness-related variation may be partially encoded internally but not exposed through token probabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 图 7 比较了 CodeLlama 和 QwenCoder 在 HumanEval+ 数据集上各层的有效秩。 尽管这些模型在 pass@1 水平上存在差异，但两者都呈现出相同的模式：在许多中间和较后的层中，生成失败的样本的有效秩高于生成成功的样本。 这表明，生成失败的样本会导致隐藏状态几何结构不够紧凑。 这与研究问题 2（RQ2）的结果形成对比，在 RQ2 中，输出标记的置信度通常无法区分成功和失败的程序。 这一结果表明，与正确性相关的差异可能部分被内部编码，但并未通过标记概率体现出来。

paragraphs.en: SE Takeaway. A confident decoding trace should not be interpreted as a low-risk program. Representation-level signals may help future tools identify candidates that appear reliable from token probabilities but still require validation.
paragraphs.zh: SE 要点。 一条自信的解码轨迹不应被解读为低风险程序。 表示层级的信号可能有助于未来的工具识别那些从词元概率上看似乎可靠但仍需验证的候选项。

paragraphs.en: Research Insight. The effective-rank separation suggests a representation-aware direction for mitigating overconfident failure. If failing generations occupy a different latent-state regime, then correctness risk is partially represented internally but not coupled to decoding behavior. Future SE research should therefore study such objectives that make these internal risk signals operational: lowering confidence, triggering deferral, or routing candidates to validation when hidden-state geometry indicates likely failure. This shifts uncertainty from an external post-hoc score to a learned mapping from representations to reliability actions.
paragraphs.zh: 研究洞察。 有效秩的分离表明，在缓解过度自信失败方面，应关注表示层面的方向。 如果失败的生成占据不同的潜在状态区域，那么正确性风险部分被内部表示，但并未与解码行为耦合。 因此，未来的 SE 研究应探索使这些内部风险信号具备操作性的目标：降低置信度、触发延迟或当隐藏状态的几何结构表明可能失败时将候选项转至验证环节。 这将不确定性从外部的后验评分转变为从表示到可靠性动作的学习映射。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest three directions for reducing overconfident failure: training, inference-time control, and reliability evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果提出了三种减少过度自信失败的方法：训练、推理时的控制以及可靠性评估。

paragraphs.en: 1) Train models to recognize likely failures. Our post-training results show that better generation does not imply better discrimination between passing and failing programs. Instruction tuning increases certainty on failing generations for both model families, while its effect on pass–fail discrimination is inconsistent. Therefore, future post-training should optimize not only whether the model generates correct code, but also whether it lowers confidence or defers when its generated code is likely incorrect.
paragraphs.zh: 训练模型以识别可能出现的故障。 我们的后训练结果表明，生成质量更高并不意味着在通过和失败的程序之间的区分能力更强。 指令微调提升了两个模型家族对失败生成的判断确定性，但其在通过-失败区分方面的效果并不一致。 因此，未来的后训练不仅应优化模型能否生成正确的代码，还应优化其是否在生成的代码可能不正确时降低置信度或推迟输出。

sents.en: 1) Train models to recognize likely failures.
sents.zh: 训练模型以识别可能出现的故障。

sents.en: Our post-training results show that better generation does not imply better discrimination between passing and failing programs.
sents.zh: 我们的后训练结果表明，生成质量更高并不意味着在通过和失败的程序之间的区分能力更强。

sents.en: Instruction tuning increases certainty on failing generations for both model families, while its effect on pass–fail discrimination is inconsistent.
sents.zh: 指令微调提升了两个模型家族对失败生成的判断确定性，但其在通过-失败区分方面的效果并不一致。

sents.en: Therefore, future post-training should optimize not only whether the model generates correct code, but also whether it lowers confidence or defers when its generated code is likely incorrect.
sents.zh: 因此，未来的后训练不仅应优化模型能否生成正确的代码，还应优化其是否在生成的代码可能不正确时降低置信度或推迟输出。

paragraphs.en: This direction requires execution-grounded training data. Each training example should connect a task and generated candidate to an execution outcome, so that high-confidence failures can be identified explicitly. Matched passing and failing candidates for the same task are particularly useful because they control for differences in task difficulty. Such data can support objectives that penalize confident failures and reward appropriate deferral. Our latent-space analysis provides an additional opportunity where passing and failing generations exhibit different internal representations even when output confidence overlaps, suggesting that these internal signals may support learned failure prediction rather than relying only on token probabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 这一方向需要以执行结果为基准的训练数据。 每个训练样本都应将任务与生成的候选结果关联到执行结果上，以便能够明确识别出高置信度的失败情况。 针对同一任务，匹配通过的候选结果与失败的候选结果尤其有用，因为它们可以控制任务难度差异带来的影响。 这类数据可以支持这样的目标：对高置信度的失败进行惩罚，并对适当的延迟决策给予奖励。 我们的潜在空间分析提供了一个额外的机会：即使输出置信度存在重叠，通过的生成结果与失败的生成结果仍会表现出不同的内部表示，这表明这些内部信号可能有助于学习预测失败，而不仅仅是依赖词元概率。

paragraphs.en: 2) Couple model confidence with external evidence at inference time. Our selective-generation results show that high confidence alone is not sufficient for acceptance. In some settings, the most certain generations contain disproportionately many failures. Therefore, inference-time systems should not map confidence directly to “accept” or “defer.” Instead, confidence should be one input to a control policy that determines what additional evidence is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 2) 在推理阶段，将模型置信度与外部证据相结合。 我们的选择性生成结果表明，仅凭高置信度并不足以接受结果。 在某些情况下，最确定的生成结果中失败的比例会过高。 因此，推理阶段的系统不应将置信度直接映射为“接受”或“推迟”。相反，置信度应作为控制策略的一个输入，该策略用于确定还需要哪些额外证据。

sents.en: 2) Couple model confidence with external evidence at inference time.
sents.zh: 2) 在推理阶段，将模型置信度与外部证据相结合。

sents.en: Our selective-generation results show that high confidence alone is not sufficient for acceptance.
sents.zh: 我们的选择性生成结果表明，仅凭高置信度并不足以接受结果。

sents.en: In some settings, the most certain generations contain disproportionately many failures.
sents.zh: 在某些情况下，最确定的生成结果中失败的比例会过高。

sents.en: Therefore, inference-time systems should not map confidence directly to “accept” or “defer.” Instead, confidence should be one input to a control policy that determines what additional evidence is needed.
sents.zh: 因此，推理阶段的系统不应将置信度直接映射为“接受”或“推迟”。相反，置信度应作为控制策略的一个输入，该策略用于确定还需要哪些额外证据。

paragraphs.en: At inference time, the system should determine what additional evidence is needed before accepting generated code. We distinguish three such cases. First, when the task specification is incomplete or ambiguous, the system should seek clarification from the developer. Second, when correctness depends on missing external information, the system should retrieve or verify that information. Third, when the risk lies in the generated implementation, the system should obtain program-level evidence through testing, analysis, or an independent evaluator. Repeated generation can support this process, but our results show that sampling alone does not resolve candidate selection and eventually reaches persistent failures. Therefore, an inference-time controller should choose among clarification, validation, regeneration, and deferral according to the expected reliability improvement and its cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，系统应确定在接受生成的代码之前还需要哪些额外证据。 我们将此类情况分为三种。 首先，当任务说明不完整或存在歧义时，系统应向开发者寻求澄清。 其次，当正确性取决于缺失的外部信息时，系统应检索或验证该信息。 第三，当风险存在于生成的实现中时，系统应通过测试、分析或独立评估者获取程序级别的证据。 重复生成可以支持这一过程，但我们的结果表明，仅靠采样无法解决候选选择问题，最终会陷入持续失败。 因此，推理阶段的控制器应根据预期可靠性提升及其成本，在澄清、验证、重新生成和推迟之间做出选择。

sents.en: Second, when correctness depends on missing external information, the system should retrieve or verify that information.
sents.zh: 其次，当正确性取决于缺失的外部信息时，系统应检索或验证该信息。

sents.en: Third, when the risk lies in the generated implementation, the system should obtain program-level evidence through testing, analysis, or an independent evaluator.
sents.zh: 第三，当风险存在于生成的实现中时，系统应通过测试、分析或独立评估者获取程序级别的证据。

sents.en: Repeated generation can support this process, but our results show that sampling alone does not resolve candidate selection and eventually reaches persistent failures.
sents.zh: 重复生成可以支持这一过程，但我们的结果表明，仅靠采样无法解决候选选择问题，最终会陷入持续失败。

sents.en: Therefore, an inference-time controller should choose among clarification, validation, regeneration, and deferral according to the expected reliability improvement and its cost.
sents.zh: 因此，推理阶段的控制器应根据预期可靠性提升及其成本，在澄清、验证、重新生成和推迟之间做出选择。

paragraphs.en: 3) Evaluate reliability through system decisions. Our results show that score-level improvements can overstate practical reliability. Calibration substantially reduces BS while BSS remains near zero in many settings, and explicit IDK prompting does not reliably induce deferral. Thus, future evaluation should assess whether uncertainty leads to better acceptance and validation decisions rather than only whether a confidence score is numerically well aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 3) 通过系统决策评估可靠性。 我们的研究结果表明，分数层面的改进可能夸大了实际可靠性。 校准能显著降低 BS，而 BSS 在许多情况下仍接近零；此外，显式的 IDK 提示并不能可靠地促使智能体推迟决策。 因此，未来的评估应关注不确定性是否会导致更优的接受与验证决策，而不仅仅是置信分数在数值上是否对齐良好。

sents.en: 3) Evaluate reliability through system decisions.
sents.zh: 3) 通过系统决策评估可靠性。

sents.en: Our results show that score-level improvements can overstate practical reliability.
sents.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，分数层面的改进可能夸大了实际可靠性。

paragraphs.en: A reliability benchmark should evaluate an end-to-end policy that can accept generated code, obtain additional validation, retry generation, or defer. The evaluation should vary the cost of accepting incorrect code and the available validation budget. The central outcome is whether the system reduces false acceptance without relying on indiscriminate deferral or unlimited validation. Such evaluation would measure whether a code-generation system uses reliability evidence appropriately under deployment constraints, rather than only whether it produces a calibrated score.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠性基准应评估一种端到端策略，该策略能够接受生成的代码、获取额外验证、重试生成或推迟处理。 评估过程中应改变接受错误代码的成本以及可用的验证预算。 核心成果在于系统能否在不依赖无差别推迟或无限次验证的前提下减少误接受情况。 此类评估将衡量代码生成系统在部署约束条件下是否恰当使用了可靠性证据，而不仅仅是衡量其能否生成经过校准的分数。

sents.zh: 可靠性基准应评估一种端到端策略，该策略能够接受生成的代码、获取额外验证、重试生成或推迟处理。

paragraphs.en: These three directions target different causes of overconfident failure. Training determines whether the model identifies likely failures, inference-time control determines how the system responds to uncertain evidence, and evaluation determines whether those responses reduce false acceptance. Ultimately, an intervention addresses overconfidence only to the extent that it reduces failing programs that remain eligible for acceptance, without relying on indiscriminate deferral or unbounded validation.

paragraphs.en: Our study has three main limitations. First, we evaluate four open-source code LLMs in the 7–8B range because our analyses require token probabilities and hidden representations and whether the findings extend to larger proprietary models remains open. Second, we study single-generation code synthesis rather than repository-scale or agentic workflows, where tool use and iterative feedback may change how overconfidence emerges. Third, our evaluation is limited to Python benchmarks with execution-based test suites. These provide practical correctness labels but do not establish complete semantic correctness or cover other languages and development settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究存在三个主要局限性。 首先，我们评估了 7–8B 参数规模的四种开源代码大型语言模型（LLM），因为我们的分析需要词元概率和隐藏表示，而研究结果是否适用于更大规模的专有模型仍是一个悬而未决的问题。 其次，我们研究的是单次生成的代码合成，而非仓库级或智能体式的工作流程；在这些流程中，工具使用和迭代反馈可能会改变过度自信产生的方式。 第三，我们的评估仅限于带有基于执行的测试套件的 Python 基准测试。 这些测试能够提供实用的正确性标签，但无法确立完整的语义正确性，也无法覆盖其他编程语言和开发环境。

paragraphs.en: This section discusses potential threats to validity in our study, organized into four standard categories: internal, external, construct, and conclusion validity. These categories address risks pertaining to our experimental design and methodology, as well as the generalizability of our findings.
paragraphs.zh: 本节讨论了我们研究中可能影响有效性的威胁，并将其分为四个标准类别：内部效度、外部效度、构念效度和结论效度。 这些类别涉及与我们实验设计和方法相关的风险，以及我们研究结果的可推广性问题。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. Our results depend on the correct implementation of uncertainty metrics, calibration methods, sampling procedures, and execution-based evaluation. We mitigate this threat by following standard definitions from prior work ( Vashurin et al., 2024 ; Fomicheva et al., 2020 ; Fadeeva et al., 2024 ; Takayama and Arase, 2019 ; Van der Poel et al., 2022 ; Darrin et al., 2022 ; Duan et al., 2023 ; Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2023 ) , reusing established implementations when available, and applying the same evaluation pipeline across models and benchmarks. For stochastic procedures, such as sampling-based uncertainty and repeated generation, we use fixed decoding settings within each experiment and compare trends across multiple models. Nevertheless, implementation details such as token filtering, sequence truncation, and score orientation may affect individual metric values.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 我们的结果依赖于不确定性指标、校准方法、采样流程和执行式评估的正确实现。 我们通过遵循先前研究中的标准定义（Vashurin 等人，2024；Fomicheva 等人，2020；Fadeeva 等人，2024；Takayama 和 Arase，2019；Van der Poel 等人，2022；Darrin 等人，2022；Duan 等人，2023；Kuhn 等人，2023；Lin 等人，2023），在可用时复用成熟的实现，并在不同模型和基准中应用相同的评估流程，以减轻这一威胁。 对于随机性流程（如基于采样的不确定性和重复生成），我们在每个实验中使用固定的解码设置，并比较多个模型之间的趋势。 尽管如此，诸如令牌过滤、序列截断和分数方向等实现细节可能会影响单个指标的值。

paragraphs.en: External validity. We evaluate four open-source code LLMs on HumanEval+, MBPP+, and BigCodeBench analyses. These benchmarks provide executable correctness labels and allow controlled comparison of uncertainty signals, but they do not cover all software-engineering settings. Our findings may not fully generalize to larger proprietary models, project-level development tasks, other programming languages, or agentic workflows with tool use and iterative repair. Metrics requiring token probabilities or hidden states also assume white-box model access, which may not be available for API-only models. Extending this analysis to closed models and repository-scale tasks remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 我们在 HumanEval+、MBPP+ 和 BigCodeBench 分析上评估了四个开源代码 LLM。 这些基准测试提供了可执行的正确性标签，并允许对不确定性信号进行受控比较，但它们并未涵盖所有软件工程场景。 我们的研究结果可能无法完全推广到更大的专有模型、项目级开发任务、其他编程语言，或涉及工具使用和迭代修复的智能体工作流程。 需要标记概率或隐藏状态的指标也假设了对白盒模型的访问权限，而仅通过 API 提供的模型可能不具备这种访问权限。 将这一分析扩展到闭源模型和仓库级任务仍属于未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. We operationalize correctness using benchmark test suites. Although HumanEval+ and MBPP+ strengthen the original tests, execution outcomes may still miss untested behaviors. Thus, our labels approximate functional correctness rather than prove semantic equivalence. We also treat token confidence, entropy, calibration scores, sampling behavior, abstention, and latent effective rank as proxies for reliability-related evidence. These constructs do not directly measure program correctness; they measure whether model-derived signals align with execution outcomes. This distinction is central to our study, but it limits claims about absolute correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 我们通过基准测试套件来操作化“正确性”这一概念。 尽管 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 增强了原始测试，但执行结果仍可能遗漏未测试的行为。 因此，我们的标签仅能近似反映功能上的正确性，而非证明语义上的等价性。 我们还将令牌置信度、熵值、校准分数、采样行为、弃权以及潜在有效秩视为与可靠性相关的证据代理指标。 这些构念并不直接衡量程序的正确性；它们衡量的是模型生成的信号是否与执行结果一致。 这一区别是我们研究的核心，但也限制了我们关于绝对正确性的结论。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion validity. Our conclusions are based on trends observed across multiple models, benchmarks, uncertainty families, and mitigation strategies. The main findings do not depend on a single metric: weak failure detection, high-confidence failures, limited local-token separation, bounded sampling gains, and unreliable prompt-level abstention appear across settings. However, exact effect sizes may vary with decoding parameters, calibration splits, thresholds, and benchmark composition. We therefore avoid claiming that uncertainty is useless. Our conclusion is more specific: the evaluated model-derived signals are insufficient as standalone reliability mechanisms for deciding that generated code is likely to pass execution-based validation.
paragraphs.zh: 结论效度。 我们的结论基于在多个模型、基准测试、不确定性类型和缓解策略中观察到的趋势。 主要发现并不依赖于单一指标：弱故障检测、高置信度故障、有限的局部标记分离、有界的采样增益以及不可靠的提示级拒绝现象均出现在不同设置中。 然而，确切的影响程度可能会因解码参数、校准划分、阈值和基准测试组成而异。 因此，我们避免声称不确定性毫无用处。 我们的结论更为具体：所评估的模型衍生信号作为独立的可靠性机制，不足以判断生成的代码很可能通过基于执行的验证。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty estimation in ML and NLG. Uncertainty estimation has been widely studied in classification, using confidence scores, entropy, Bayesian approximations, ensembles, and calibration methods to identify unreliable predictions ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2018 ; Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ; Alon et al., 2019 ; Xiao and Wang, 2019 ; Vasudevan et al., 2019 ; Corbière et al., 2019 ; Monarch, 2021 ; Steinhardt and Liang, 2016 ; Shannon, 1948 ) . Recent work extends these ideas to natural-language generation through token uncertainty, sequence likelihood, sample diversity, semantic uncertainty, and judge-based estimates ( Vashurin et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Bakman et al., 2025 ; Ielanskyi et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Baan et al., 2023 ; Niwa and Iso, 2024 ; Kuhn et al., 2023 ) . Code generation differs because correctness is determined by executable program behavior rather than textual plausibility or subjective quality. Our work studies whether these uncertainty signals remain useful under execution-based correctness.

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty and calibration for code models. Prior work has studied uncertainty, calibration, and reliability signals for code models ( Li et al., 2024a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Vasconcelos et al., 2022 ; Spiess et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Sharma and David, 2025 ; Johnson et al., 2023b ; Rathnasuriya and Yang, 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Rakasi et al., 2026 ; Johnson et al., 2023a ; Rathnasuriya et al., 2025 ) . These studies show that code models can be miscalibrated and that post-hoc methods can improve confidence alignment. Our focus is different: we study whether model-derived uncertainty can support reliability decisions for generated code, such as identifying likely failures, abstaining, or deciding when additional validation is needed. This setting is distinct from uncertainty in non-generative SE tasks such as defect prediction or vulnerability detection ( Li et al., 2021 ; Rathnasuriya et al., 2025 ) , where predictions are labels over existing artifacts rather than generated programs whose correctness is observed only after execution.
paragraphs.zh: 代码模型的不确定性与校准问题。 先前的研究已探讨了代码模型的不确定性、校准与可靠性信号（Li et al., 2024a；Peng et al., 2025；Ni et al., 2023；Tian et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2025；Vasconcelos et al., 2022；Spiess et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2024；Sharma and David, 2025；Johnson et al., 2023b；Rathnasuriya and Yang, 2026；Shi et al., 2026；Rakasi et al., 2026；Johnson et al., 2023a；Rathnasuriya et al., 2025）。 这些研究表明，代码模型可能存在校准偏差，而事后方法能够改善置信度对齐。 我们的研究重点有所不同：我们探讨模型推导出的不确定性是否能为生成的代码可靠性决策提供支持，例如识别潜在故障、选择放弃生成，或判断何时需要额外验证。 这一场景与非生成性软件工程任务（如缺陷预测或漏洞检测）中的不确定性存在显著差异（Li et al., 2021；Rathnasuriya et al., 2025），因为在后者中，预测结果是对现有工件的标签，而非正确性仅在执行后才能观察到的生成程序。

paragraphs.en: Code-generation evaluation and mitigation. Code-generation research commonly evaluates models with pass@1, pass@k, execution feedback, repair, and prompting strategies ( Li et al., 2024a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . These methods measure or improve the ability to produce correct code, but they do not fully address whether a model can recognize when its own output is likely to fail. Sampling can increase the chance that a correct candidate exists, but does not identify which candidate should be trusted. Prompt-level abstention can expose a deferral option, but does not guarantee safe generate-or-defer behavior. We evaluate these techniques as responses to overconfident failure rather than as general performance-improvement methods.
paragraphs.zh: 代码生成评估与缓解。 代码生成研究通常通过 pass@1、pass@k、执行反馈、修复和提示策略来评估模型（Li et al., 2024a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024a）。 这些方法衡量或提升了生成正确代码的能力，但并未完全解决模型能否识别自身输出可能失败的问题。 采样可以增加存在正确候选答案的可能性，但无法确定应信任哪个候选答案。 提示层级的拒绝可以提供一个延迟选项，但无法保证“安全生成或延迟”的行为。 我们将这些技术视为应对过度自信导致失败的对策，而非通用的性能提升方法。

paragraphs.en: Summary. Our work provides a rigorous characterization of the dilemma of overconfidence in code LLMs: model-derived uncertainty is available during generation, but it does not reliably identify generated programs that fail execution-based evaluation. The results position overconfident failure as a deployment-facing SE reliability problem and motivate future mechanisms that connect model self-assessment to execution-grounded correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 我们的工作对代码 LLM 中过度自信困境进行了严谨的刻画：模型在生成过程中可获得不确定性信息，但该信息无法可靠地识别出在执行评估中失败的生成程序。 研究结果表明，过度自信导致的失败是一个面向部署的软件工程可靠性问题，并为未来将模型自我评估与基于执行的正确性相连接的机制提供了动机。

paragraphs.en: This paper characterizes the dilemma of overconfidence in execution-grounded code generation. We show that model-derived uncertainty often fails to identify incorrect programs, even under calibration, sampling, and abstention prompting. These results motivate behavior-aware evaluation that measures high-confidence failures, generate-or-defer behavior, and reliability under limited validation budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 本文描述了在执行导向的代码生成中过度自信所引发的困境。 我们发现，即使经过校准、采样和拒绝提示，模型产生的不确定性通常仍无法识别错误的程序。 这些结果促使我们提出一种行为感知的评估方法，该方法可衡量高置信度下的失败情况、「生成或推迟」的行为，以及在有限验证预算下的可靠性。
